item.title:
In Brooklyn, a Christian man was surrounded and harassed by masked anti-Israel protesters last year.
“I’m Hamas, what are you gonna do?” “You’re looking at Hamas in the eyes!” “You want violence? Bring the violence!”
The targets of this kind of extremism aren’t just Jews or “Zionists.” Time and time again, they prove this movement is not about “peace”, it’s about intimidation, aggression, and inciting violence on American streets.

Whoever is responsible must be arrested, and prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.

item.title:
French Jewish woman moves to Israel to enlist in the IDF’s Search and Rescue Brigade after witnessing surge in antisemitism following the October 7, 2023, Hamas massacre:
Private G., who made aliyah (moved to Israel) from France, enlisted in the Home Front Command's Search and Rescue Brigade, accompanied by her brother while her parents remained in France. "I grew up my whole life in France, but after October 7 [2023] I saw all the antisemitism there, how Jews hide their identity and how many people simply hate us," she said. "I understood that I couldn't just stay and do nothing, continuing to live a comfortable life while my people are suffering. I felt that I had to do something for my people." After exploring several IDF units, she chose the Search and Rescue Brigade because "being a soldier in the army of Israel, in a brigade that saves and rescues people, is the strongest answer to hatred and antisemitism." She now joins the brigade during Operation Roaring Lion, declaring, "I'm ready to give my very best!”. We salut you! 🇮🇱 via: IDF

On Saturday I went to my synagogue.
I was checked by security at the gates. I passed protective railings, and then a guard at the front door buzzed me in. Another guard waited inside.
Just wondering. Is this normal for Christians, Muslims or Hindus in the UK? Or only for Jews?
